the design and analysis of a video server with a parallel disk storage subsystem, and with the support of a range of interactivities at the video server.
the design of scalable video servers that support heterogeneous QoS on parallel disk arrays.

the following issues: (1) how to support a wide range of interactive QoS at a scalable video server; (2) how to improve the utilization of a video server by exploiting scalable video; (3) how to reduce the complexity of admission and scheduling control at the video storage unit; and (4) how to provide a flexible and scalable video server architecture.

the proposed video server is scalable in terms of both the number of users and the number of disks.
the data placement scheme presented in this paper is an effective way to improve the interactivity performance of video servers with heterogeneous QoS.

a heterogeneous QoS video server can be constructed using a parallel disk array with our proposed data placement strategy.
a scalable video server with heterogeneous QoS can be implemented on a single, independent parallel disk array with a data placement strategy.

a video server can provide a range of QoS by using scalable video and a flexible data placement strategy.
a flexible data placement strategy can support a range of interactivities on a parallel disk array and can improve the performance of a video system.
